name: ADRONITIS
source:
In "ADRONITIS" you play as a person who has kidnapped a man after obsessively stalking him for months on end, but after spending a bit of quality time with him, you aren't quite sure if you even like him that much...

Maybe by the end of the week you can decide what to do with him, if he doesn't decide what he'll do to you first.

[from [url=https://thesleepingdead.itch.io/adronitis]itch.io[/url]]
